profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Sylphase

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led the Android development team for ground control station software development
- Improved build system performance of clean builds by 100%, and incremental builds by 500% via CMake and Gradle optimizations. Increasing developer productivity by 5% across the department.
- Created dockerized REST API and mobile UI for edge computer configuration
- Introduced and spearheaded modern Android best practices to the Android development team. Hilt-Dagger, Jetpack Compose, Room, Kotlin, Flow-based event driven data handling.
- Preformed user testing/interviews and Figma mockups to identify and implement high impact features
- Provided support and mentorship to junior software engineers

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-(Acquired by AeroVironment)
- Created a physics based UxV simulator in Unreal Engine 5 used to train users for Kinesis ecosystem. Supports quadcopter, winged, and tracked vehicles.
- Created a RTSP GStreamer based hardware accelerated video streaming service within Unreal Engine 5, running on Xavier NX hardware. Similar to Unreal Engine Pixel Streaming technology. Used to stream simulated UxV video feeds. Operates at 24+ FPS in 10W mode. A 300%+ increase over previous solution.
- Built configuration website for edge computing hardware with Python Flask. Allowing users to modify edge computer settings via browser.
- Created tool in Unreal that generates Slippy Tile Images used to create tile-sets of virtualized worlds. Allows for rendering in Kinesis mobile app.
- Created a customer facing account portal using React, Typescript, GraphQL, Prisma, Postgres, Tailwind (RedwoodJS) stack. Allows for a single source of truth after sales self-service supports.
- Created offline documentation Android app leveraging Next.js to allow for a fully automated pipeline from markdown files to publishable Android app. Used for reading multi-media documentation in an offline scenario.
- Built CI/CD pipeline using AWS CDK tool to automatically provision S3, AWS Lambda, RDS, API Gateway. Reducing commit to prod time from 3 days to 30 minutes.
- Built Unreal Engine 5 CI/CD pipeline running on Windows OS and GitLab CI Runners
- Wrote NodeJS SDK for a 3rd party licensing tool, in order to allow for self-service licensing feature. Reducing customer service time from 3 round trip email events, to self-serve in 2 minutes.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Unreal Engine · AWS · JavaScript · React.js

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Created custom foam manufacturing-on-demand React/Redux e-commerce website
Created 2.5D CAD tool with Three.js that provides real time product customization
Implemented OpenCV image processing pipeline to generate CAD data of hand tool assets
Fine tuned and deployed Pytorch based AI image segmentation service backend via Docker based system
Created customer facing human-in-the-loop system to generate ground truth datasets for neural network 
Created Feather.js based REST API w/ Postgres based datastore for backend order fulfillment
Setup and maintained CI/CD system via Bitbucket Pipelines using 12 factor app principles
Handled all aspects of fulfillment via C02 laser based CNC machines
Scaled sales/fulfillment capability from $0 to $100k+ in revenue

positions.title: Laboratory Engineer
positions.description:
Delivered mechanical design feedback to students for semesterly EML4502 (Mechanical Engineering Senior Design 3) project
Wrote realtime Feather.js app to transmit and visualize data from prototype assistive robot
Wrote React/ThreeJS application to generate and display end effector toolpath data for 3d bioprinter project
Deployed and administered Solidworks PDM software system for classroom use
Created SMS student feedback system using Twilio API and Google App Scripts, used by over 150 students semesterly
Provided in-house rapid hardware prototyping services using CNC equipment
Procured, deployed and managed in-house 3d FDM printer farm, and Haas machining center
Revamped and implemented a multitude of 5S/lean lab improvements
positions.insights: Skills: 3D Computer Aided Design (3D CAD) · CAD/CAM

positions.title: Advanced NC Programming Systems Development Intern
Team Captain
positions.description:
Led Formula SAE team of 30+ members  to 2nd place overall finish (of 120 teams) for 2015 FSAE Michigan competition; best in UF history
Conducted weekly meetings with team to manage project deliverables and mitigate project risks
Managed team resources and labor to create Gator Motorsport's first aerodynamic package on 2015 vehicle

positions.title: Mechanical Engineer
positions.description:
Developed CNC programs and workflow for majority of parts for  FSAE race vehicle
Deployed and managed in-house Confluence/Jira server for in-house knowledge management
Performed over 50% of manufacturing operations for the 2013 UF FSAE race vehicle
Implemented macros, tool standardization, and new CAM software increasing CNC  productivity by 40%
Reversed engineered Honda CBR600RR oiling system for dry sump integration
